tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Free. Find restaurants in MacrosMap by name and/or near a location. Returns names, addresses and how many menu items have macro data. Use before the paid tools to check coverage.

tools.name: get_item_macros
tools.description: Get calories, protein, carbs and fat for a specific menu item at a restaurant (e.g. "Chipotle chicken burrito bowl"). Returns the closest matching items with match scores. Costs $0.002 USDC; not charged if nothing matches.

tools.name: find_items
tools.description: Find menu items at a restaurant that fit macro targets, e.g. the highest-protein items under 600 calories at Chick-fil-A. Filter by max calories, min protein, max carbs, max fat; sort by protein, calories or protein per calorie. Costs $0.005 USDC; not charged if nothing matches.

tools.name: get_restaurant_menu
tools.description: Get the full menu for a restaurant with calories, protein, carbs and fat for every item. Costs $0.02 USDC; not charged if the restaurant is not found.
